title: Uncanny X-Men #39
desc:
"THE SCAVENGED" PART TWO

Wolverine has mentored many young mutants, offering protection and guidance. But what happens when four damaged young mutants want to follow in his footsteps, but only AFTER making sure he's out of the way for good?

They're the best there is at what they do, but what they do is HOMICIDAL.
